svg.title: The trust boundary between Muse Spark 1.3 and the deterministic engine
svg.desc: On the left, the model reads evidence and proposes values from finite lists. In the middle, a dispatcher enforces an allowlist, strict schema, frozen identity, run-issued evidence, the finite domain and budgets. On the right, the engine constructs, rebuilds, checks, replans and compares. Typed feedback returns to the model. The model's own statements are stored with authority: none.
